title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 053 ]

blocks.text: Even our most highly educated guesses often go disastrously wrong. Albert Einstein remarked, “There is no chance that nuclear energy will ever be obtainable.” Why is predicting the future so difficult? Would it be smart not to try to guess what’s coming next? Not predicting the future would be like driving a car without looking through the windshield. We desperately need people who can foretell the future. They help us narrow the infinity of possible futures down to one or, at least, a few. We look at the present and see the present; they see the seeds of the future. They are our advance scouts, going secretly over the border to bring back priceless information to help the world to come.

readingSentences.english: Even our most highly educated guesses often go disastrously wrong.
readingSentences.korean: 우리의 가장 많이 교육받은 사람들의 추측도 종종 비참하게 잘못될 수 있다.

readingSentences.korean: Albert Einstein은 “핵에너지를 얻게 될 가능성은 전혀 없다.”라고 말했다.

readingSentences.korean: 미래를 예측하는 것은 왜 그렇게 힘들까?

readingSentences.korean: 다음에 올 일을 추측하려고 하지 않는 것이 현명할까?

readingSentences.english: Not predicting the future would be like driving a car without looking through the windshield.
readingSentences.korean: 미래를 예측하지 않는 것은 자동차 앞 유리를 통해 앞을 보지 않고 차를 모는 것과 같다.

readingSentences.korean: 우리는 미래를 예견해줄 사람을 몹시 필요로 한다.

readingSentences.english: They help us narrow the infinity of possible futures down to one or, at least, a few.
readingSentences.korean: 그들은 우리를 무한히 가능한 미래를 하나, 혹은 적어도 몇 개로 좁히게 해주는데 도움을 준다.

readingSentences.english: We look at the present and see the present; they see the seeds of the future.
readingSentences.korean: 우리는 현재를 살펴보면서 미래를 보지만 그들은 미래의 씨앗들을 본다.

readingSentences.english: They are our advance scouts, going secretly over the border to bring back priceless information to help the world to come.
readingSentences.korean: 그들은 앞으로의 세상을 돕기 위한 귀중한 정보를 가져오기 위해 비밀스럽게 경계선을 넘어 가는 우리의 정찰대이다.
